## Install

`jsonc
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "plugins": [
    "@devdengchao/opencode-plugin-filterable-table"
  ]
}
`

Or pin this version:

`jsonc
"plugins": [
  "@devdengchao/opencode-plugin-filterable-table@0.1.1"
]
`

## Changes

- Published the plugin as a public scoped npm package
- Added GitHub Actions Trusted Publishing with OIDC and npm provenance
- Added npm installation instructions and npm badges
- Updated development dependencies and normalized lockfile registry URLs

## Notes

- Tested with OpenCode Desktop 2.2.1
- The Desktop GUI plugin API is experimental
- TUI is not supported
